AlternateTargets: a certification stamped with a winter-melon seal
Senses.Note: Four critical deployments span four independent masters and works.

Occurrences.Kwic: 近日宗風掃地，魔鬼興妖，到處妄稱知識，冬瓜印子妄相印可，互相牽引入無間獄。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1437.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian. Yongjue Yuanxian condemns false teachers who use winter-melon seals to authorize one another.

Occurrences.Kwic: 妄判先宗以死殺法，定要把冬瓜印子印人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB171.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Tianyin. Tianyin Yuanxiu says such claimants insist on stamping people with a winter-melon seal.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸方貴圖門庭熱鬧，每到解夏、解冬，抬出冬瓜印子，將半青半黃、不死不活的禪和打上幾箇，說是傳佛心印。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB187.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tian’an Sheng. Tian'an Sheng says teachers bring out the winter-melon seal and stamp half-ripe practitioners as bearers of the Buddha-mind seal.

Occurrences.Kwic: 檗云：『雖然如是，子已喫吾三十棒了也。』冬瓜印子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB410.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lianfeng. Lianfeng caps Huangbo’s threatened thirty blows with the verdict “winter-melon seal.”

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The book title and enclosing commentary identify Lianfeng as the commenting speaker; the standalone headword is his capping remark.

Senses.Explanation: A winter-melon seal is a crude stamp of certification: it marks people as approved while supplying only the shape of a true seal. Chan masters use the image to attack indiscriminate recognition, formulaic authorization, and premature claims of transmission. Yongjue condemns teachers who stamp one another; Tianyin attacks people determined to stamp students; Tian’an describes seasonal teachers stamping half-ripe practitioners; and Lianfeng caps Huangbo’s threatened blows as the same crude stamp.
